description: Source code for MPSEvent and MPSEventPool classes managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) events, including recording, waiting, notifying, and timing functionalities within the at::mps namespace.

classes.name: MPSEvent
classes.description: Represents a Metal Performance Shaders event for synchronization and timing.

classes.name: MPSEventPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of MPSEvent objects for reuse and efficient event handling.

methods.name: recordLocked
methods.description: Records the event with optional timing, ensuring stream completion.

methods.name: waitLocked
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled with optional synchronization.

methods.name: notifyLocked
methods.description: Sets up a notification callback for the event.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event, with optional locking.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the event, with optional locking.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sets up a notification callback, with optional locking.

methods.name: notifyCpuSync
methods.description: Signals CPU synchronization completion.

methods.name: waitForCpuSync
methods.description: Waits for CPU sync to complete.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Performs synchronization and CPU notification.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the event has been signaled.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the event with a new stream and timing setting.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Acquires an event from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Clears the event pool cache.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases an event back to the pool.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records a specific event by ID.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event by ID.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes a specific event by ID.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of a specific event by ID.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: getInUseEvent
methods.description: Retrieves an in-use event by ID, optionally locking.
